consent.title: Usage statistics
consent.body: Let %BRAND% remember this device with an anonymous ID, so we can see how your visits connect over time? If you say no, we only count single page visits and button taps and link them to nothing. The data stays in %BRAND%'s own database, is never shared with advertisers, and is deleted after 13 months.
